counting_convention: One distinct unresolved specification field per entry; per-instruction-class or per-queue-family vectors count as one field. Capacity/mapping/policy/functional behavior are functional; latency/frequency/service rate are timing. Implementation-only gaps and already established capacities are excluded.
scope: Current GEMM-path hardware specification; not all possible RTX internals. Counts may increase when broad fields are decomposed or new mechanisms are discovered.
